title: Whitened Summand Norm Bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in(-1,1)$, let $a$ be a real coefficient vector on $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be one of those coordinates, and let $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The cube of the norm of the summand after applying the inverse square root of the correlation matrix is at most $(\sqrt{2}|a_i|/\sqrt{1+\rho})^3$ if $x_i=y_i$, and at most $(\sqrt{2}|a_i|/\sqrt{1-\rho})^3$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector on $n$ coordinates
